data.one_liner: iOS‑style sectioned list view with sticky headers
data.what_it_does: CupertinoListView renders a vertical list of sections, each with a header that stays pinned while scrolling. It supports dynamic and static children, empty sections, and custom separators.
use_when: Building an iOS‑styled list with sticky section headers
Need a simple API similar to ListView.builder for grouped data
Want to display empty sections with only a header
Integrating with scroll_to_index for programmatic scrolling
avoid_when: You only need a plain ListView without sticky headers
You require Android‑style Material design list views
You need complex custom section widgets beyond the provided builder
strengths: Sticky headers out of the box
Flexible builder API for dynamic/static content
weaknesses: Limited to sectioned lists, not arbitrary grids or carousels
data.minimal_example:
CupertinoListView.builder(
  sectionCount: data.length,
  itemInSectionCount: (s) => data[s].items.length,
  sectionBuilder: (ctx, path, _) => Text(data[path.section].name),
  childBuilder: (ctx, idx) => Text(data[idx.section].items[idx.child]),
  separatorBuilder: (ctx, idx) => Divider(indent: 20.0),
  controller: _scrollController,
);
